agents.name: Data Agent
agents.purpose: Dataset integrity, preprocessing, artifact hashing

agents.name: Performance Agent
agents.purpose: ML metric evaluation against rolling baseline

agents.name: Security Agent
agents.purpose: Dependency CVE scanning, artifact integrity

agents.name: Quantum Security Agent
agents.purpose: Cryptographic posture (signatures, suites, key lifecycle)

agents.name: Red Team Agent
agents.purpose: Byte-tamper tripwire, provenance, regression perturbation

agents.name: Training Optimization Agent
agents.purpose: Sample / feature / seed adequacy heuristics

agents.name: Incident Response Agent
agents.purpose: Model-state denial/critical/repetition analysis

agents.name: Governance Agent
agents.purpose: Model-state compliance and registry hygiene

agents.name: Optimization Agent
agents.purpose: Storage/registry hygiene, stale-version detection

agents.name: Entity & Asset Resolution Agent
agents.purpose: Maintains a cross-period asset-inventory view per entity; flags assets present in the prior assessment that vanished from the current one (decommission vs. silent reporting gap)

agents.name: Ingestion Agent
agents.purpose: Parse CSE submissions (CSV/JSON/JSONL/SQLite), canonical normalization, atomic persistence, source provenance

agents.name: Normalization Agent
agents.purpose: Resolve cross-references (alert → case → step → escalation), emit a frozen CanonicalDataset for downstream workers

agents.name: Execution Gap Agent
agents.purpose: Six SIH-EG detectors — fast closure, ack-without-investigation, critical-without-escalation, repeated investigations, recurring-without-remediation, metric gaming

agents.name: Negative Space Agent
agents.purpose: Detect absence of expected evidence — missing file, missing investigation, missing escalation, missing disposition, missing monitoring, unexpectedly low activity

agents.name: Workflow Reconstruction Agent
agents.purpose: Reconstructs the ordered event timeline per case from raw timestamped records and flags temporal-sequence violations: escalation after closure, disposition before investigation, declared-sequence-vs-chronology mismatch

agents.name: Anomaly Agent
agents.purpose: Robust statistical anomalies (median/MAD/percentile) on per-entity rate distributions

agents.name: Peer Benchmark Agent
agents.purpose: Cohort-based robust baseline + 7 peer metrics with trimmed-mean / MAD confidence and limitations

agents.name: Coverage Gap Agent
agents.purpose: SIH-EG-05 / SIH-NS-06 — controls deployed but not monitored; monitoring blind spots vs expected intervals

agents.name: Drift Agent
agents.purpose: Longitudinal KPI drift with matched-period baselines and robust change-point detection (cross-period intelligence)

agents.name: Cross-Entity Insights Agent
agents.purpose: SIH-ADD-05 — common weaknesses / repeated patterns / outliers across the entity roster

agents.name: Case Similarity Agent
agents.purpose: SIH-ADD-03 — deterministic edit-distance on investigation sequences; flags template / suspiciously identical patterns

agents.name: Evidence Completeness Agent
agents.purpose: SIH-ADD-06 — counts / linkage / field coverage / temporal coverage / manifest reconciliation

agents.name: Correlation & Signal Fusion Agent
agents.purpose: Cross-finding corroboration: clusters signal findings sharing a scoped subject and flags cross-detector-family corroboration, ahead of and independent from risk scoring (Phase P26)

agents.name: Entity Risk Scoring Agent
agents.purpose: SIH-AN-01..07 — risk fusion: 7-dimension decomposable entity risk profile, explainable aggregation, consuming the correlation clusters from satsa.correlation_fusion as supporting evidence

agents.name: Prioritization Agent
agents.purpose: SIH-AN-08 — explainable entity + finding priority (lexicographic: high-impact → evidence-backed → materially-affected → repeated → aging)

agents.name: Recommendation Agent
agents.purpose: SAT-SA decision vocabulary — bounded, evidence-backed human-action hints (INSPECT_INVESTIGATION, REQUEST_EVIDENCE, REVIEW_ESCALATION, REVIEW_MONITORING, REVIEW_CONTROL, COMPARE_PEERS, REVIEW_TREND)

agents.name: Review Workflow Agent
agents.purpose: SIH-ADD-08 — human review capture (confirm / reject / defer / escalate / annotate); append-only decision audit bound to the finding's content digest at decision time

agents.name: Trust-Provenance Agent
agents.purpose: PQC (ML-DSA-65) sign + verify every run and every finding; hash-chain evidence ledger; deterministic content digests; integrity of source → record → observation → finding → risk → recommendation → decision

agents.name: Evidence & Explainability Assembly Agent
agents.purpose: Assembles the uniform WHAT/WHY/EVIDENCE/CONFIDENCE/LIMITATIONS/RECOMMENDATION decomposition every finding renders through, plus drill-down linking — a single source of truth the UI now actually calls, replacing logic that was duplicated inline

agents.name: Supervisory Audit & Compliance (Meta-Audit) Agent
agents.purpose: Sweeps every run, every signal finding, and every review decision in the database and verifies trust-receipt and provenance-binding coverage — a database-wide compliance check, not the single-run verify_run() check

agents.name: Supervisory Report Generation Agent
agents.purpose: Assembles a supervisory report (entity risk decomposition, findings, evidence, drill-down links) as printable/exportable HTML — was real, working code that had never been formally registered as one of the roster's agents

agents.name: Validation Agent
agents.purpose: Per-layer + composition validation; expert labels; synthetic ground truth; performance benchmark; offline guarantee; extended in Phase P26 with a governed threshold-calibration workflow (propose -> test against labeled data -> supervisor approval -> versioned deployment, satsa.analysis.calibration)
